sanskrit: yāḥ preṅkhe preṅkhayante santāne mālavā iva | (…) ||
english: Those [Apsarases] who swing upon the swing, clinging like mālavā creepers along the span — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yāḥ purastād ācaranti sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ | (…) ||
english: Those who move in the east together with the rays of the Sun — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yā adharād ācaranty anasā chadisā saha | (…) ||
english: Those who move from below together with a cart and its canopy — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yāḥ paścād ācaranty andhena tamasā saha | (…) ||
english: Those who move from the west together with blind darkness — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yā uttarād ācaranti varṣeṇa vidyutā saha | (…) ||
english: Those who move from the north together with rain and lightning — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yā adhastād udvīkṣante sācy akṣi karikratīḥ (…) ||
english: Those who gaze upward from below, with sidelong eye, of strange deeds — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yā upariṣṭād avekṣante nīle vyaktāni bibhratīḥ | (…) ||
english: Those who look down from above, wearing blue [garments] with [their] markings visible — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yā antarikṣa īrayanti vātena reṣmaṇā saha | (…) ||
english: Those who roam through the atmosphere together with the wind and the storm-blast — [the rest of the verse is not preserved].

sanskrit: yā nadīr iti catasraḥ ||
english: Those [who are] the four rivers.

sanskrit: tvaj jātā rudra śantamā tvaṃ hi no babhuryā irāya bheṣajebhiḥ | vi yakṣmān yāvayāsmad vy aṃho vy amīvāś cātayāsmad viṣūcīḥ ||
english: From you, O Rudra, the most beneficent [remedies] are born; for you have become the bounteous one for us, for refreshment and healing. Drive away the disease-afflictions from us, drive away the anguish; chase far from us the diseases that spread in all directions.

sanskrit: tvaṃ devānām asi rudra śreṣṭhas tavas tavasām ugrabāho | hṛṇīyasā manasā modamāna ā babhūvitha rudrasya sūnoḥ ||
english: You are the foremost of the gods, O Rudra, the most mighty of the mighty, O strong-armed one; rejoicing with a gracious mind you have become [what you are as] the son of Rudra.

sanskrit: tvaṃ hi no vīrām̐ īraya bheṣajebhir uruṃ no bhavanta maghavo marutvan | karā naḥ pāram aṃhasaḥ svasti viśvā abhītīr apa sedhāsmat ||
english: Rouse up heroes for us with your medicines; may you, O bounteous lord accompanied by the Maruts, become wide [in your favour] for us. Carry us across to the far shore of distress in well-being; ward off all terrors from us.

sanskrit: tvaṃ hi no vṛṣabha cakṣimeṣṭhā asmai rudrāyogrāya mīḍhuṣe | kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matiṃ yathā naḥ śam aso dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
english: You, O bull, are the greatest in sight [and in glory]; to this Rudra, the fierce and bountiful, the lord of heroes, we offer our prayer — that you may be auspicious to us for the biped and auspicious for the quadruped.

sanskrit: kva teṣu rudra hasto mṛḍayāko jalāṣaḥ | apabhartā rapaso daivyasya ||
english: Where, O Rudra, is that hand of yours among these — the merciful, the healing, the cooling one — that removes the divine affliction?

sanskrit: pra yakṣmaḥ pra nirṛtir etv asmat seneva sṛṣṭā pracatām amīvā | ārādhvaṃ sanā vṛjanā jahīta ||
english: Let the wasting disease, let Nirṛti go forth from us; let disease depart like an army put to rout. Away, away — leave behind your ancient haunts!

sanskrit: arhan dhanur hitaṃ bibharṣy arhan niṣkaṃ rajantaṃ viśvarūpam | arhann idaṃ dayase viśvam ejan na te dūraṃ na pariṣṭhāsti te bhava sadyaḥ sarvān pari paśyasi bhūmim ||
english: Worthy [of worship], you bear the strung bow; worthy, [you wear] the gleaming necklace of all forms. Worthy, you rule over all this moving [world]; nothing is far from you, nothing is beyond your reach — be present now; you behold all the earth on every side.

sanskrit: namas te astu vidyute namas te stanayitnave | namas te astv aśmane yena pradiśam asyasi ||
english: Homage to you, O lightning; homage to you, O thunder; homage to you, O thunderbolt, with which you hurl [destruction] in every direction.

sanskrit: mā devānām ugra rājann asmākaṃ puruṣā riṣan | rakṣāṃsy asmad yakṣmāṃś ca nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā ||
english: O fierce king among the gods, may our people not be harmed; we destroy the rākṣasas and the disease-afflictions from us with the sacred word.

sanskrit: brahmaṇeto nāśayāmo yat kiṃ cāṅgeṣv āmayat | śalyān yakṣmasyātho ropīs tā ito vi nayāmasi ||
english: With the sacred word we destroy here whatever afflicts the limbs; the splinters of disease, and also the festering sores — these we lead away from here.

sanskrit: nayāmi vāṃ paśupatī ghṛtenājyena vardhayan | yaṃ dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi tasya veśaḥ kariṣyathaḥ ||
english: I lead you both, O Paśupati [and his consort], strengthening [you] with ghee and clarified butter. Him whom we hate and who hates us — his dwelling shall you two destroy.

sanskrit: adhi brūtaṃ paśupatī dvipade me catuṣpade | prasūtau yatra jaghnatus tato me mātaraṃ riṣat ||
english: Speak forth, O Paśupati [pair], on behalf of my biped and quadruped. Where the two who gave birth [have] struck, from there let my mother not be harmed.

sanskrit: yā vāṃ rudraḥ śivā tanū yā vāṃ santi rogaṇāḥ | yā vām āyuṣmatīs tanūs tābhir no mṛḍataṃ yuvam ||
english: The auspicious body that belongs to you two, O Rudra [pair]; the disease-inflicting forms that you two possess; the life-giving bodies that you two have — with those be merciful to us, you two.

sanskrit: na pra minanti vratino vratāni satyaṃ jinvanto vidathā vadantaḥ | yasyeme rodasī ubhe saṃyukte manasā hṛdā ||
english: The keepers of vows do not transgress their vows, speaking truth, quickening the sacred rites, [attending] the assemblies — he to whom these two worlds, both, are joined in mind and in heart.

sanskrit: sa prajānāṃ prajāpatiḥ sādhu rakṣati varṣati | sa veda ratnabheṣajaṃ devebhyas pary ābhṛtaṃ tena no mṛḍataṃ yuvam | jīvātave na martave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
english: He is Prajāpati of creatures; he duly protects and gives rain. He knows the jewel-medicine fetched from among the gods; with that be merciful to us, you two — for the sake of living, not of dying, and for the sake of unimpaired wholeness.

sanskrit: saguṇāsa āsate saṃyuktā balāya kam | teṣāṃ yad indriyaṃ vṛha cati rocati rocanā ||
english: The virtuous ones sit united together for strength indeed. Whatever vital power belongs to them — it grows; the shining [firmament] shines.

sanskrit: ye te rocane bṛhatī antarikṣe atho divaḥ | tābhyām upa pra yāhi naḥ sarvavīrām̐ ariṣyataḥ ||
english: Those two great shining [realms] of yours, in the atmosphere and also in heaven — through those two come to us, [keeping] all our heroes unharmed.

sanskrit: sarvavīrā ariṣyanto rocane adhi tasthima | yathā nas tṛṣṇamad vasu divi kṣipadbhyo apsu yā ||
english: All our heroes, unharmed, have taken their stand in the shining [realm]; may the refreshing wealth in heaven — [that which goes] to those who cast [offerings] and that which is in the waters — come to us.
